description.en: The audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported.

description.zh:
语料标识，当设备调用多个语料进行组合播报时，通过该标识播报指定的语料。

- 当**语料类型**选择为**自定义语料**时，该参数必选。语料标识由用户自定义，支持英文字母和数字，长度为1~32个字符，项目下保证唯一。建议将语料语义的拼音首字母设置为语料标识，例如：`支付到账`设置为`ZFDZ`。

- 当**语料类型**选择为**常用语料**时，语料标识由系统自动生成，无需用户自定义。
description.en:
The corpus identifier. When a device invokes multiple corpora for combined playback, this identifier specifies which corpus to play.

- When the **corpus type** is set to **Custom**, this parameter is required. The identifier is user-defined and can contain English letters and digits, with a length of 1 to 32 characters. It must be unique within the project. We recommend using the initials of the pinyin representation of the corpus semantics as the identifier—for example, use `ZFDZ` for `支付到账`.

- When the **corpus type** is set to **Common**, the system automatically generates the corpus identifier, and no user-defined value is needed.

description.zh: 是否启用声码，若传入了true，必须传入参数SoundCodeConfig，否则调用会失败。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable sound code. If you set this parameter to true, you must also provide the SoundCodeConfig parameter; otherwise, the invocation will fail.

实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>  

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation will fail.  
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.  
></notice>  

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过[项目管理控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID。如果没有项目，可以创建项目后获取项目ID。
description.en: The project ID, which is the UUID of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Management Console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects). If you do not have a project, create one and then retrieve its ID.

description.zh:
声码配置，包含字段如下：


- **SoundCodeContent**：声码营销内容，例如商品的详情地址等。

- **AdditionalDuration**：语料播放结束后的声码播放时长，单位为秒，取值范围为1～15。
description.en:
Sound code configuration, which includes the following fields:  
- **SoundCodeContent**: Marketing content for the sound code, such as the product detail URL.  
- **AdditionalDuration**: The playback duration of the sound code after the speech material ends, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 15.
The speech rate. Valid values: -500 to 500.

description.zh:
语料类型，分为自定义语料和常用语料。

> 不传入此参数时或传入**custom**，必须传入参数Text和BizCode，否则调用会失败。

- 自定义语料（默认）：取值为**custom**，是自定义语料时，必须填写语料标识和语料文本。
- 常用语料：由系统预置的常用语料文本，包括以下类型：
    - 数字：取值为**number**，包含：数字0~9，点，幺。
    - 量词：取值为**measure_word**，包含：个，十，百，千，万，十万，百万，亿等。
    - 货币单位：取值为**monetary_unit**，包含：分，角，元等。
    - 时间单位：取值为**time_unit**，包含：时，分，秒，月，日，年等。
    - 单位时间：取值为**unit_time**，包含：每秒，每分，每小时，每天，每周，每月，每年等。
    - 长度单位：取值为**length_unit**，包含：毫米，厘米，分米，米，千米，公里，英寸，英尺，英里等。
description.en:
The type of speech material, which can be either custom or preset.  
> If this parameter is not specified or is set to **custom**, you must provide the Text and BizCode parameters; otherwise, the invocation will fail.  
- Custom speech material (default): Set this parameter to **custom**. When using custom speech material, you must specify both the speech material identity and text.  
- Preset speech material: System-provided common speech texts, including the following categories:  
    - Numbers: Set this parameter to **number**. Supported content includes digits 0–9, "point", and "yao" (a colloquial term for "one").  
    - Measure words: Set this parameter to **measure_word**. Supported content includes "ge", "shi", "bai", "qian", "wan", "shi wan", "bai wan", "yi", etc.  
    - Monetary units: Set this parameter to **monetary_unit**. Supported content includes "fen", "jiao", and "yuan".  
    - Time units: Set this parameter to **time_unit**. Supported content includes "hour", "minute", "second", "month", "day", and "year".  
    - Unit time expressions: Set this parameter to **unit_time**. Supported content includes "per second", "per minute", "per hour", "per day", "per week", "per month", and "per year".  
    - Length units: Set this parameter to **length_unit**. Supported content includes "millimeter", "centimeter", "decimeter", "meter", "kilometer", "gongli" (Chinese term for kilometer), "inch", "foot", and "mile".

description.zh: 语料文本，当语料类型选择为自定义语料时，该参数必选。语料文本支持英文字母、汉字和空格，长度为1~100个字符，一个汉字占两个字符。
description.en: The corpus text. This parameter is required when the corpus type is set to Custom. The text supports English letters, Chinese characters, and spaces. The length must be 1 to 100 characters, where each Chinese character counts as two characters.

description.zh: 语料播报声音，由系统预设，例如标准女声、标准男声等。可以选择的声音类型通过[GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~)进行查询，填入返回参数中**VoiceList**中**Value**的值。
description.en: The voice used for speech synthesis, predefined by the system (for example, Standard Female Voice or Standard Male Voice). You can query available voice types by calling [GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~) and use the **Value** field from the **VoiceList** in the response.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 20.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
